offer.text: They went out past the treeline in the spring and nobody has seen them since. I am not asking you to bring them home. I am asking you to find out.

accept.text: Deep in the woods. Further than you think is sensible.

decline.text: No. I would not know where to start either.

in_progress.text: Further out. They would not have stopped this close.

ready.text: You found them. You actually found them.

complete.text: Alive. Thin, and stubborn, and alive.
